PLAN "12-Week Couch-to-5K Plan for Exercise-Induced Asthma - Male, 24"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary cardio:
    name "Complete 5K in 12 weeks with gradual progression and asthma-friendly pacing"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Intro to Run-Walk":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 1x2..3 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
          Walk 1x2..3 min rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Technique and Endurance Foundation":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x2..3 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Progressive Run Intervals":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x1..2 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Steady Build":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x2..3 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Active Recovery + Core":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          Walk 10x1 min rpe 2 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Longer Effort with Pacing":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x3..4 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Increase Run Time":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x2..3 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Mobility and Tempo Prep":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x3..4 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Progressive Distance":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x4..5 min rpe 3 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Aerobic Foundation":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 5x1..2 min rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Hill Prep (if safe) or Incline Walk":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x2..3 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Technique and Core Work":
        warmup:
          brisk_walk 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x2 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Structured Progression":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 5x2..3 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Tempo Prep and Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x4 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Mixed Run Pace":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x3 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Gradual Distance Increase":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x6 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Aerobic Endurance Boost":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x5 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Recovery Run + Mobility":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x4 min rpe 3 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Consistency + Endurance":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x6 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Progression Run":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x4 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Cadence and Form":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 6x2 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Steady State Build":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x5 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Tempo Push":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x6 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Quality Endurance":
        warmup:
          jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 5x3 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
  PHASE "Phase 4" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Long Run Foundation":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x9 min rpe 4 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Progression Run":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x6 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Form and Recovery":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 4x4 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Steady State Run":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 5x5 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Tempo Build":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x8 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Aerobic Recovery + Mobility":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x6 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Taper Prep":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x10 min rpe 5 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Race Pace Simulation":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 3x8 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Friday training 45m "Recovery Focused Run":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x6 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          stretch 5m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Taper Start":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 2x4 min rpe 4 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Final Prep Run":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 1x6 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Race Simulation and Cool Down":
        warmup:
          light_jog 5m
        main straight_sets:
          RunWalk 1x8 min rpe 5 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          walk 5m

Notes:
- Warm-ups emphasize gradual activation with inhaler as prescribed; include gentle breathing drills (diaphragmatic, nasal breathing if tolerated).
- RPE targets are kept moderate to accommodate exercise-induced asthma; adjust speed to maintain controlled breathing.
- Hydration, cold-air considerations, and a plan to use inhaler pre-session if advised by GP.
- If symptoms arise (wheezing, chest tightness not relieved by inhaler, coughing lasting >24 hours), reduce intensity and consult clinician.
